description: What does Japan's National Tax Agency (NTA) publish for this 13-digit corporate number? Returns the name, furigana, English name, kind, location, assignment date and, when the record states it, the closure date with the recorded cause code and successor corporate number (no reason is inferred). Optional change history. Distinguishes not found in the NTA records from could not check. Carries the NTA Web-API source statement. Not an official result.

corporate_number.description: 13-digit Japanese corporate number (houjin bangou), e.g. 7000012050002. The check digit is verified; nothing is requested for an invalid number.

include_history.description: true: also return the NTA record of changes (name, location, closure), oldest first. Default false.

name: nta_corporate_number_lookup

attribution.description: Required source statement of the NTA Corporate Number System Web-API terms (Article 6; source_statement_ja is the required wording), the source notice with the retrieval date, and the statement that this is processed by MK Career Planning and is not an official government result. Keep it when you pass results on.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: listed / not_found_in_checked_records / unknown (see unknown_reason). A failure or a missing application ID is never reported as not found.

status_as_of.description: lastUpdateDate stated by the NTA Web-API.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

unknown_reason.description: One of upstream_not_configured, rate_capped, too_many_results, upstream_access_restricted, upstream_app_id_rejected, upstream_error, record_withdrawn when status is unknown.

title: National Tax Agency record for a corporate number
